scope: deterministic graphics and real driving event handlers with DOM adapter
checks: rain layers are deterministic, finite, center sight line softened
reduced motion and FX off leave no frozen rain/speed scratches
rain atmosphere and weather draw never change race state or use game RNG
two pointers control steer and throttle independently, global release and lost capture clear them
blur, hidden and pagehide save a transition once, clear held input and never auto-resume
rotation pauses safely and destroy removes input/lifecycle handlers
fallback touchcancel releases the matching touch, unrelated IDs are ignored
